name: MrScraper
one_liner: AI-driven web scraping API that returns structured data from web pages, with a hosted scraping browser.
auth_notes: API token created in dashboard (app.mrscraper.com/api-tokens, name and expiry), sent in x-api-token header; Marketplace endpoints use Authorization Bearer.
access_notes: Free plan with no credit card; token self-serve from dashboard. Paid: Essential plan, extra usage $1 per 1,000 tokens; Enterprise by booking a call.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve free token, documented REST endpoints (AI scraper, scrape JSON/markdown, results, bulk, analytics) with simple header auth. Free-tier limits unverified.

auth.quote: Include your API token in the x-api-token HTTP header on every request
authenticate using the standard RFC 6750 Authorization header with a Bearer token

access.quote: Free costs nothing - no credit card required.
Sign in to the dashboard, open your account settings, and copy the token from the API Token page.

api_surface.quote: Create and run a new AI Scraper from natural language instructions using the MrScraper API

webhooks.quote: Results can go straight to webhooks, SQL databases, AWS S3, Zapier, n8n, or email

disputes.why: Docs show token creation self-serve, many documented endpoints, free plan without card; first pass lacked these pages.
No gate found on auth, plan or approval.
llms.txt lists roughly two dozen or more documented endpoints; exact count unverified.
Auth page and pricing page now verified.
